findings.description: render_finish applies the pending remainder with make_step and then calls render_progress, but both can be skipped or defeated when make_step returns early. make_step returns early when less than 1 second has passed since last_eta, so the ETA and position-related state may not update.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a short progress run, under 1 second since last_eta, with a length that is not a multiple of update_min_steps. make_step increments pos and may set finished, but the early return skips the ETA update. render_progress then renders the new pos, so the bar likely does land, though the ETA can be stale. This is a weak concern; the main risk is that render_finish becomes non-idempotent if called twice.
